title: Review guides of a change
description: Body of a `report` artifact: the REVIEW.md guides of the areas a change touches, as a reviewer's brief points at them (docs/design/handbook.md#review-guides-reviewmd). Rendered by the engine from the repository's `docs/review/` at the run's landing target, never by a model; only the guides whose area paths a changed path matches are in `text`, or every guide when the change's paths could not be read (INV-2).

guides.description: The guides `text` holds, in file order.

sha256.description: Hash of the guide's text as read.

left.description: How many guides of the repository were left out because no changed path is in their area.

problems.description: Guides that could not be used, and why (a malformed guide is named, never silently dropped).
